title: Kiritani Haruka — The Future We're Wishing For〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm starting to get the hang of being a shrine maiden.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It seems much calmer out there now, so I should be able to check in with the others to see how they're doing.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
I see someone hunched over. I hope they're okay.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's a girl. She looks around our age. Maybe younger... But I'm not seeing any friends or family members. Is she all alone out here?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me.
Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I'm just a little tired...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
But you don't look so well. I think you should rest for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's a bench right over there where we can sit. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I really appreciate it. I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
You really didn't look well back there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? Are you sure you're okay now? Is something still bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: N-No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I don't know if I should be asking a shrine maiden about this but...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I... I ran away from home...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What?
Why...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: My parents and I got into a fight over my future...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I really love baking...
So I brought up the idea of me going to a vocational school where I can learn to be a patisserie.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: They rejected me by saying I have my head in the clouds...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
That's why I came here.
My wish is to make it so they'll say yes to my decision.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But I can't actually wish this away, can I...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe the opposite...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe any wish can be granted as long as you have faith in it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, do you have an idea of what it's like to be a patisserie...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah, I did some research online, and even asked around at some local bakeries and cake shops.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: They told me that I have to have the mental and physical stamina to be able to cope with a long and arduous process that doesn't always reward you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Mental and physical stamina...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That reminds me of the time a professional pastry chef came to teach ASRUN how to make cakes. They mentioned the exact same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (For a time, they were only allowed to clean and check inventory. And when it got busy, they hardly had enough time to get any sleep.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But they're always able to get through all of that because they know somebody's waiting for their cake to arrive on their special day.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you mind me asking why you decided to want to become a patisserie in the first place...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Huh?
Why...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your parents told you that you have your “head in the clouds”, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What if they just don't fully know or understand your reasoning behind wanting to become a patisserie? Wouldn't that help convince them of your decision?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: You're right. I don't think I explained everything to them well enough...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If that's the case, I believe you'll have no problem getting them to understand.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Now I see what they meant by what they said...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: One year, I made my mom a birthday cake and she really loved it. I still remember the way she smiled like it happened yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I know that's what I need to tell them now...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm sure you'll do a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
A-Again, thank you so much...
I'm so glad I came here today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Likewise. I'm glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's starting to get dark, so please watch your step.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I will!
Bye, and thanks again!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I hope I didn't pry too much...
Still...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I hope her dream comes true...)

rows.Speaker: Shrine Visitor
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me!
Could you point me towards the shrine office?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes...!
It's right this way!
